message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a dark background and a prominent red left-hand margin. At the center, an individual in a blue work uniform, a yellow safety vest with a blue and red lightning bolt logo, and a white hard hat is being carried on the shoulders of another similarly dressed individual. The upper individual reaches upward with yellow-gloved hands toward a grey electrical meter box mounted high on the wall. A thin, crooked branch extends from their right hand toward the meter.

The title "MATI LAMPU, TUMBUH GERUTU" is printed in large, bold red letters on the right. Below it, white text reads: "Mati setrum mendadak yang melanda sepertiga Pulau Jawa membuat PLN kalang-kabut. Lalai atau sabotase?" 

At the top, white text reads: "AMENDEMEN KONSTITUSI: SELAMAT DATANG, ORDE BARU". Behind the figures, the word "TEMPO" appears in large, translucent red letters. The bottom right corner contains a barcode and publication details: "12-18 AGUSTUS 2019", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
